entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with G.R Case No.7 of 2024 pending on the file of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-Cum-Special Judge(POCSO), Gajapati arising out of Serango P.S. Case No.20 of 2024 for commission of offence alleged under Sections 417/ 420/ 376(2)(n)/ 376(3)/ 313/
323/ 354/ 354-B/ 506 of IPC.
3. Learned counsel, on instruction, submits that except the present BLAPL, no other bail application of the Petitioner relating to the aforementioned P.S. case is pending in any other Court.

4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Addl.
Sessions Judge-cum-Spl. Judge(POCSO), Paralakhemundi by order dated 25.06.2024 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
5. It is stated by the learned counsel for the State that notice has been served on informant on 28.08.2024.
There is no appearance on behalf of the Informant, when the matter is called.
6. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 28.02.2024 and as charge sheet has already been filed on 05.04.2024, he may be released on bail.

sentences.text: 7. Learned counsel for the State opposes such prayer.

8. Perused the 164 Cr.P.C statement of the victim.
9.
Considering the same, this Court directs the Petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.
10. It is further directed that the Petitioner shall not in any way try to intimidate the informant and her family.
11. It shall be open for the informant/prosecution to seek variance of this order in the event there is any threat perception.

12. Additionally, it is directed that the Petitioner shall appear before the jurisdictional police station once every month on such date and time to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin till the conclusion of trial.
Certification of such appearance shall be submitted to the Court in seisin.
13. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
14. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.

(V. NARASINGH)
 SOUMYA Judge Signed by: SOUMYA RANJAN SAMAL
